context: Tatsuya visits the city, sees Mei with baby Hikari.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: メイさん、ひかりちゃん、元気そうで、よかった。
lines.en: Mei-san, Hikari-chan — you both look well. I'm glad.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine warmth. Low register, unhurried. Lands softly on each name with real affection. No performance—just a man acknowledging what matters to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 達也さん、いつも、ありがとうございます。
lines.style: Tender and formal at once. Slight catch of emotion held steady. Soft voice, slow pace. The gratitude is real, not performative—it settles in the silence she leaves.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: お祖父さん代わり、しっかり、やるで。
lines.en: I'll be the grandfather figure she needs. You can count on that.
lines.style: Firm conviction underneath the gentleness. Voice deepens slightly on the promise. Not boastful—just a quiet man stating what he will do. Small pause before the final word.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本当に、ひかりちゃん、皆さんに、囲まれて、幸せ。
lines.en: Truly, Hikari surrounded by all of you—I'm happy for her.
lines.style: Soft wonder, almost meditative. Voice opens on 'surrounded,' lingers there. No rush. The depth of her feeling settles in the spaces between words.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Brief, complete. Gentle affirmation. A small nod in the voice. Warmth without excess—just enough to close the circle.
